svg.title: How Inkling draws
svg.desc: How Inkling draws. Your text → Parser. Parser → Diagram model. Diagram model → Layout (dagre). Layout (dagre) → Humaniser. Humaniser → Sketch pen (rough.js). Sketch pen (rough.js) → SVG. SVG → <inkling-diagram>. SVG → Image URL. SVG → Markdown fence. Note on Humaniser: wobble, tilt, letter jitter. Note on Sketch pen (rough.js): seeded: same text, same drawing.
